definitions.gloss: to that extent, so much, that much
definitions.explanation: To such a degree (referring to something distant from both speaker and listener).

examples.japanese: あんなに⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧。
examples.english: Even though I tried so hard.

examples.japanese: あんなに⟦{美味|おい}しい→おいしい：00740_oishii⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧。
examples.english: This is the first time I've had such delicious food.

examples.japanese: あんなに⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦{聞|き}かなかった→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: Even though I told him so much, he didn't listen.

examples.japanese: あんなに⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|す}いた→すく：00756_suku⟧。
examples.english: Even though I ate so much, I'm already hungry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あんなに⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧だった⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{疲|つか}れやすくなった→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: I used to be so energetic as a child, but lately I get tired easily.

notes:
Refers to a degree or extent of something distant from both speaker and listener. Often conveys surprise, frustration, or emphasis.

KO-SO-A-DO SERIES:
- ⟦こんなに→こんなに：02812_konnani⟧: this much (near speaker)
- ⟦そんなに→そんなに：01646_sonnani⟧: that much (near listener)
- あんなに: that much (far from both, or past events)
- ⟦どんなに→どんなに：03494_donnani⟧: how much (question/exclamation)

USAGE:
- Very often used with past tense to refer back to something: あんなに⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧ (even though I tried so hard)
- Frequently paired with ⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧ to express regret or frustration
- Can modify adjectives, verbs, or entire clauses

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あんなに〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: despite doing/being ~ so much
- あんなに〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: I didn't expect ~ to that extent
